changelog: Initial release: Full QRdex.io API support (url, email, wifi, sms, whatsapp, telephone). Includes Python CLI client and API reference.
summary: Create, manage, and track QR codes using the QRdex.io REST API. Use when working with QR code generation, URL shortening with QR codes, WiFi QR codes, email/SMS/WhatsApp QR codes, scan tracking, or any QRdex.io operations. Supports all QR types (url, email, telephone, sms, whatsapp, wifi) with customizable colors and shapes.
